texts: Reduction of the cumulative LoE AR
note: Reference variant; 64 subsets, exact. Shares are of P5 Ambitious at full strength from 2027 minus TL. The hatched bar is the separate effect of starting P5 Ambitious at full strength in 2027 instead of on the adopted adoption path (not a Shapley player). TL is a hyper-optimistic theoretical limit; a thought experiment, not a pathway: all assumptions at full strength from 1 January 2027, combining best observed attributes of different buildings and places; not a proposal or a feasible pathway (potentials hierarchy: theoretical > technical > realisable).
